info.name: Bridge API (Bridge Data Output) Agents RESO Web API API

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: The dataset identifier the request is scoped to.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Bridge access token. Optional when an Authorization Bearer header is supplied.

items.docs: Returns the RESO Web API (OData) metadata document describing the available resources and fields for the dataset.

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: The dataset identifier the request is scoped to.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Bridge access token. Optional when an Authorization Bearer header is supplied.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression (e.g. ListPrice gt 500000). Names are case sensitive.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated OData field selection.

params.name: $top
params.description: OData page size (v2) / collection size (v3).

params.name: $skip
params.description: OData number of records to skip.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: OData ordering expression (e.g. ListPrice desc).

params.name: $expand
params.description: OData related resources to embed (e.g. Media, Member, Office).

items.docs: Returns RESO Data Dictionary Property records. Supports $filter, $select, $top, $skip, $orderby, and $expand (e.g. Media, Member, Office). Feed types such as /idx may be appended in the path.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated OData field selection.
